title: Useless Sport and Drunkenness Robs Our Heavenly Honor
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahuma salli wa sallim wa baarik `alaa habeebika wa nabiyyika, Sayyidina Muhammad,
Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa’l-akhireen. Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa
ridwaana. Madad yaa Sayyidi, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Thumma salaamu `alaykum
yaa `ibaadillahi ‘s-saaliheen! As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh.
O People! Who are attending and asking to hear, to listen and obey Allah Almighty's holy orders, we are
giving a heavenly salute to you. May Allah (swt) forgive us and bless you. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
We are weak servants.
O People from East to West! O Children of Adam! Listen and obey. All the prophets (a) from every time, and
particularly the Seal of Prophets (s), took heavenly orders that reached them through Archangel Gabriel.
None of them addressed people on their own; if Allah Almighty did not send Archangel Gabriel, they would
not know what to say or how to deal with people.

O People of the 21st Century! Think about the prophets. You lost your way and yourself, because no one is
asking, "Who am I? How did I come to this life? From where did I come? To where am I going?" Instead, the
whole world puts so much importance on playing football, not thinking about anything of value. They say
there is an economic crisis and they are very sorry about that, and some kingdoms and republics are now
bankrupt. When they come to this world, they forget (their Lord); now only sports are important and nothing
else.
Even animals know sports are useless. People do not examine what they see or find, which is the biggest
blame for those who claim to be the most civilized people from the beginning of the world to the end.
At what other time did people play sports: football, volleyball, basketball, baseball or hockey? How did people
in our time become no-thinking ones, with heads like an empty football? Sometimes they cry or are very
angry or very happy. That is the biggest blame for Mankind, with no one asking, "Who am I?" Arabs say they
are very angry with their leaders because they lost at football.
Now, 21st century people are like children, to be entertained. What is that? They are not thinking about
anything serious, what we are doing and how we came here. They say, "We came from our mothers and
fathers, who were very happy to bring us into this bad world, and that is what we know about ourselves.”
They think they came from najis, filth, to another dirty place. That is the limit of what they know about
themselves and it is a pity, because they are losing their very precious, temporary life. It is a short time and
no one knows when they will pass away. What are their missions? They don't ask.
People now are falling into the deepest crisis. For what? They are taking gold, giving paper (currency) and
saying, "Use it." They are cheating people with paper money, saying there is an economic crisis. Previous
societies never used paper money, not even Pharaoh. They say, "O Shaykh! It doesn't matter because the
paper money is better for the government and for us. We are helping the government by using it."
Paper money can be copied, but because they are drunk they are not thinking about it. Now most countries
print their money like they print a newspaper! The governments are asking to make much more money, only
to enjoy themselves. No one is asking if the money is real or counterfeit! (...)
Many people drink alcohol day and night and therefore never understand anything. That is a sign the Last

Days that are approaching, that people are following Shaytan and he is playing with them. They are leaving
the prophets, never following the holy commands of Heavens, so they are without honor. Now people don’t
think about honor; they are only asking to eat and drink, thinking one’s honor doesn't matter. Now
everything in the 21st Century is imitated; they are even trying to make imitated (cloned) children!
O Mankind! All of you, from east to west and from north to south, you must think about yourselves and know
you are the most honored ones, more than angels! Allah Almighty put His Divine Secret in you! Angels asked
to receive that honor and Allah (swt) said, "No. I created the Children of Adam for this honor."
O People! You must think about the honor Allah (swt) granted you, an honor that angels will not reach in a
billion years! It is a pity they are following Shaytan, leaving the holy ones and their righteous advisers. They
are reaching an end and now there is trouble everywhere, with every kind of curse coming to wake up people!
O People! There is such a trumpet blowing, to make people see they are on the wrong way. Come to the right
way, or you will bring curses on yourselves that you will regret! This message is for all nations, from east to
west! No one can say Jesus Christ (a), Sayyidina Musa (a), or Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana Shaykh
stands and sits) asked for such a life. All the prophets asked for an honored life here and Hereafter.
O Mankind! Keep your honor; live an honored life! If not, you will be following Shaytan to Hell, in this life
and the Hereafter!
O People! We are asking forgiveness from Allah Almighty. I am sorry sometimes I am angry and my power
comes down; particularly, I shout when a message comes from holy people.
People are wearing such strange clothes, and what is the meaning of them? The Pope and the holy ones in
Christianity, Judaism, and Islam also, are not thinking, "Why are we wearing this dress?" Is it to collect
money or jewels, or to make high buildings to show that you are an important one? No, the important one in
the Divine Presence may be a poor person and his clothes may be torn. Allah Almighty is not looking at your
dress, but at your hearts.
You must keep your Lord's Holy Name!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah …

Huu, Huu, Huu, Huu, Huu...
Haqq, Haqq, Haqq, Haqq, Haqq...
Hasbun ’Llahu wa ni`ma ‘l-Wakeel...
For the honor of Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
